upstream.verifiedMethod: the installed wheel's own LICENSE file (standard BSD 2-clause text, 'Copyright 2018-26 scikit-fem developers') + METADATA Classifier 'License :: OSI Approved :: BSD License' — verified ON THE WHEEL, not the repo page

integration.notes: Plane-stress FEA solving service (Slice 22, phase5 contract §14) — the solve_fea broker op's engine. numpy+scipy only (no system deps, no GB-scale env).

limitations: v1 scope (contract §14.7): linear plane stress on rectangular domains with per-edge supports and uniform traction/shear loads — no plane strain, no 3D, no modal/buckling, no adaptivity

Per-element stress statistics are P0 mass-lumped element MEANS (a linear field's mean = its centroid value) — the clamp stress concentration is under-read ~6% at refinement 4 by design of the projection (recorded in the harness case notes)
Upstream is a small-maintainer project — pin the exact version (engines-requirements.txt: scikit-fem==12.0.2) and re-verify the analytic pins on any bump

validation.note: fea cases: uniform-tension MACHINE-PRECISION (16 pins, max rel err 1.7e-13 — the linear exact field reproduced verbatim by tri6), cantilever end-shear vs the Timoshenko closed form (rel 4.7e-3 at refinement 4, inside the 1% mesh-tolerance pin), under-constrained rigid-mode refusal verbatim; double-run byte-identical documents
